scope: October same-session controlled local-resolution experiment; September unused

rules.cross_validation: Supplementary EQ excludes the evaluation technique; frozen prior filters already saw this session, so this is a development stability check.
rules.confidence: Joint raw SNR over background, adequate fixed anchors and per-octave-scaled energy relevance. Group coverage, sign consistency and MAD lower fitting confidence.
rules.regularization: Same physical-frequency curvature, outside-zero response and coefficient penalties for all grids. Filter peak bandwidth matches estimation octave width; all score variants use common 1/12 octave masks.
rules.implementation_audit: Initial physical-curvature coefficient 0.06 numerically suppressed almost all fine-filter gains (<0.1dB for most 1/12 sections); it was changed to 0.002 before the meaningful resolution comparison. This remains an exploratory development study, not a preregistered independent experiment.
rules.selection: Finer must gain >=0.2dB LOTO group MAE without >5 percentage-point extra worsening. New middle EQ must gain >=0.15dB versus frozen current. Last piece omitted from fit and candidate choice.

application_scope.reason: Fine middle correction improves tonal group averages but worsens percussion middle balance; preserve the earlier middle filter for percussion. This is manual profile selection, not an automatic technique classifier.
